answer: Vertex Bond Registry: a new identity must lock 250 POA for 90 days in the Pearl bond and register one hardware-backed key as its vertex, an anchor never reusable for a second identity. A duplicate vertex is rejected automatically, and a sponsor who vouches for a fake identity loses its own bond. The Knoll Queue admits only 40 new identities per day, so an attacker wanting 3,000 Sybils must lock 750,000 POA for 3 months and obtain 3,000 distinct hardware anchors and sponsors risking bonds, while an honest agent pays only the refundable deposit.
